stories.h: Network Researchers Nail Down Theory of ‘Perfect Resilience’
stories.t: When links in a communication network go down, messages can get routed in a loop. Computer scientists now know that four simple network structures are to blame.

stories.h: Scientists turn Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks for future lunar bases
stories.t: Scientists have found a way to 3D-print Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks, raising the possibility of building lunar bases using materials already on the Moon.
